children: CanAsia Energy Corp (V.CEC) Hit a new 52-Week High of 43 cents. CanAsia Energy reports 2026 second quarter consolidated financial and operating results. Net income was $18.9 million ($0.17 per share) in the second quarter of 2026 compared to net loss of $0.9 million ($0.01 per share) in the second quarter of 2025.
Canfor Corp (T.CFP) Hit a new 52-Week High of $16.25. Recent mill closures have been "gut-wrenching" as the forestry industry faces tough market conditions, the chief executive of Canfor Corp. said.

Highway 50 Gold Corp (V.HWY) Hit a new 52-Week High of 80 cents. Monday, Highway 50 announce the discovery of an extensive zone of gold mineralization at its 100%-owned Gold Knob gold project in north-central Nevada.

Kolibri Global Energy Inc. (T.KEI) Hit a new 52-Week High of $9.40. Kolibri reports revenue $22.5 million in Q2 2026, a 109% increase year-over-year, marking the highest quarterly revenue in company history. Net Income was $8.5 million, or $0.24 basic EPS, compared to $2.9 million and $0.08 per share in Q2 2025, an increase of nearly 200%.

Logan Energy Corp. (V.LGN) Hit a new 52-Week High of $1.19. Logan announced its operating and financial results for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The Company's Operating Netback before hedging averaged $38.57 per BOE ($33.18 per BOE after hedging) for the second quarter of 2026, up 50% from $25.71 per BOE ($27.86 per BOE after hedging) in the same quarter of 2025, driven by materially higher crude oil prices together with lower per unit operating costs which averaged $7.53 per BOE during the quarter.

NV Gold Corporation (V.NVX) Hit a new 52-Week High of 77 cents. Late in August, NV completed a first tranche of its non-brokered private placement whereby it issued 1,759,052 units at a price of $0.40 per Unit for gross proceeds $703,620.80. Each Unit consists of one common share and one-half of one transferable common share purchase warrant.
Orezone Gold Corp. (T.ORE) Hit a new 52-Week High of $2.97. Orezone announced Wednesday an updated Life-of-Mine plan for its recently acquired Casa Berardi gold mine, located in Quebec.

Riverside Resources Inc. (V.RRI) Hit a new 52-Week High of 45 cents. Riverside Resources intersects near-surface Gold and Base Metal Mineralization at Union Norte and Advances Multiple Targets for Phase 2B Drilling.
South Star Battery Metals Corp. (V.STS) Hit a new 52-Week High of 26 cents. No news stories available today.
Total Energy Services Inc (T.TOT) Hit a new 52-Week High of $37.06. No news stories available.

Valeura Energy Inc. (T.VLE) Hit a new 52-Week High of $15.25. Valeura announces an exploration discovery near its Manora oil field and completion of a successful development and appraisal drilling campaign on its Jasmine field, in the Gulf of Thailand.
Xcite Uranium Inc. (C.XRI) Hit a new 52-Week High of 35 cents. No news stories available today.

STARDUST METAL CORP (V.ZIGY) Hit a new 52-Week Hit of $2.07. The stock Wednesday graduated to the TSXV - now trading under "ZIGY", with greater visibility, liquidity and access to institutional capital.
